name: Schema.org Accommodation
description: Adds Schema.org/Accommodation to the JSON-LD structured-data output.
project_description:
Features 
 Provides Schema.org/Accommodation to the JSON+LD structured data.

 Post-Installation 
 
 Install the module as usual. 
 Go to /admin/config/search/metatag and edit the preferred content type 
 Fill in the additional fields under @VacationRental fields with node tokens 
 
 For more information on the VacationRental schema, check https://schema.org/Accommodation 

 Additional Requirements 
 This module requires the schema_metatag module.

It can also be usefull to add the schema_vacation_rental module.
